description: This file defines the Success controller class for the checkout success page in an OpenCart e-commerce application. It handles displaying the order success message, managing session data after a successful order, and preparing the breadcrumb navigation and page layout.

classes.name: Success
classes.description: Controller class managing the checkout success page; it clears session data post-order and constructs the success page view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked for the success page; sets page title, clears session data related to the order, builds breadcrumb navigation, and prepares the view layout with necessary components.
